summary: Money's weakest part is still bank import, and every problem the user reported is reproduced on kos-redraw-1. All seven reconstructed Santander exports (midata comma, Windows-1252, semicolon/blank-first-line, Online Banking CSV with its preamble, .txt, QIF, OFX) are refused at step 1, because the importer reads line 1 as an exact-match header and knows only CSV. The duplicates come from a de-dupe key of date|amount|payee TEXT: re-importing with a different mapping, confirming a recurring rule, or typing the same payment all create twins; the same key also throws away genuine identical same-day payments inside one statement, and the app's own export re-imports every expense as income. After import nothing helps the student: raw bank strings, everything in Other, Type and Balance discarded, no batch history or undo after the dialog, and on iPhone and iPad portrait an entry cannot even be opened for editing (its Edit/Delete render below the whole list). The inventory also found thin-evidence leniency in Money goals ('5 no-spend days ✓ Met' on an account with no entries), a 14-day window that silently drops unconfirmed recurring payments, editor state bugs (Out→In saves income under Food; editing a transfer into a pot-to-pot move duplicates it), and a dead Payday picker. Root causes: no import pipeline (format detection → normalise → identity → categorise → reconcile), identity by display text instead of by source (FITID/balance/row hash), and master-detail layouts stacked on touch without changing the interaction.
coverage:
INVENTORY MATRIX (full table in audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/findings/money-goals.inventory.md). Sizes: mac 1470x832, ipad 820x1180, ipadl 1180x820 (touch threshold applied at every width this time), iphone 402x874; themes Graphite, Atelier Dawn (now renders: --theme works) and shop theme azure-butterfly. Accounts: seeded (+117 Money entries, 4 rules, 2 pots, 3 budgets) and empty (reset).
Views: Overview P mac/ipad/ipadl/iphone/Dawn, B low-data + chips → C12,C16, no-spend chip folded into the goals-leniency finding | Transactions P all sizes + azure, B filters/search/range/select/bulk/edit → C18,C19, new phone-selection, search, bulk Set category, Out→In editor, transfer edit | Budgets P mac/ipad/iphone, B inline edit, Edit budgets, rollover (verified OK: −20 rollover, effective 80), archive/restore, payday → new payday-picker, income-categories | Recurring P all, B due cards, confirm/skip/unmark, rule editor every unit/ends → C14, new 14-day window, row a11y, setPrice | Pots P mac/ipad/iphone, B move form (balance check OK), hero choice, close → C13, new closed-pot | Month P mac, B same-length compare, row links, export → C10,C11, new month links/export | Year P mac, B figures → new set-aside/income-line | Phone section switch → C8,C20 | Import dialog P mac/ipad/iphone, B 9 sample files through the real dialog (File on the input), Done-step undo (OK 3→0) → C0–C7,C9,C17, new identical-rows, own-export, odd amounts, lower-case i, 80-row cap | Export → new own-export round trip, CSV formula cells.
Engine fixtures verified OK: monthly dom 31 → last day, 29 Feb yearly, count/end dates, price history math, skip of a confirmed occurrence removes its entry, payday periods, rollover, splits must add up, refunds, Wishlist mirror (appears, cannot be deleted, Collection budget = Wishlist limit), notices (trial tomorrow, bill in 2 days, income late; figures dropped when hidden), set-aside per month (£111.43), subscriptions totals.
Goals (Money types only): money-no-spend and money-spend-under fixture on the empty account → new leniency finding; money-subs-under OK; money-income and money-save read only; goal page hidden amounts → new P3. Carried Goals findings C15, C21 rechecked.
NOT checked: kos_money cloud replication (needs a signed-in Supabase account; code read only); full-backup exportAll/importAll restore (data-integrity area); the ten Assistant money tools (assistant-archive area); PDF statements (no import path exists — covered by the formats finding); pot picture upload with a real file; VoiceOver/keyboard walk beyond the day chart's key handler (code read).

findings.title: Duplicate transactions after re-importing: de-dupe key includes payee, so a second import mapped differently is all 'new'
findings.detail: Re-run on kos-redraw-1: importing the same two rows with Description→Payee then Description→Note gives preview {dups:0, rows:2} and both import again (stored: one row with payee=bank text, one with payee '' and the text in note — exactly the 'Other' twin in the user's screenshot). Same mapping re-imported: dups 2 (correctly caught). Key unchanged. — Exactly the user's screenshot: the same Heron Foods row twice, once titled with the payee and once titled 'Other' with the bank text as the subtitle. Reproduced: import a statement with Description->Payee, then the same file with Description->Note (or payee unmapped); preview reports 0 duplicates and every row imports again. The key is date|minor|payee.lower(), and an empty payee never equals the first import's payee. The second row reads 'Other' because txRow falls back to the category name when payee is empty and shows the note as the sub-line.
findings.evidence: js/core/money.js:1025-1031 (key date|minor|payee), js/modules/money.js:587,591; eval scratchpad t2.js: reimportNoteMapped {dups:0, rows:2}, reimportSame {dups:2}; shots/money-goals/tx-dups-all-mac.png
findings.fix: Key duplicates on date+amount+kind+normalised bank text (payee OR note OR raw description, stored as tx.raw), with the bank's own id (OFX FITID / balance-chain) when present; keep the raw description on every imported row; offer 'Replace the previous import of this period' in the preview when a batch overlaps.
findings.rootCause: Dedupe depends on user-chosen mapping; raw source text not kept.

findings.title: Santander midata CSV is refused: 'Merchant/Description' and 'Debit/Credit' headers are not recognised
findings.detail: Through the REAL dialog (File set on the input): midata-comma.csv and midata-cp1252.csv both fail at step 1 with 'It has no header row with a date and an amount. Nothing was imported.' — the mapper that could fix it is never shown. — The midata export's header 'Date,Type,Merchant/Description,Debit/Credit,Balance' maps only Date; GUESS has no pattern for 'Merchant/Description' (payee) or 'Debit/Credit' (signed amount), so read() fails with 'It has no header row with a date and an amount.' before the user ever reaches the column mapper, even though the mapper could have fixed it by hand. Reproduced through KOS.money.csv.parse/guess on money-samples/midata-comma.csv: mapping {date:0}, dialogAccepts false.
findings.evidence: js/core/money.js:970-977 (GUESS), js/modules/money.js:937-940; dialog run over money-samples/midata-comma.csv, midata-cp1252.csv
findings.fix: Add patterns (merchant/description, debit/credit, 'amount (£)', 'money in/out (£)'); and never hard-fail on unguessed headers: open the Columns step with the unmatched columns and let the user map them.
findings.rootCause: Exact-match header regexes plus a hard gate before the manual mapper.

findings.title: Import only reads the first line as the header: midata with a leading blank line or a semicolon delimiter, and Online Banking CSV with an account preamble, all fail
findings.detail: Dialog run: midata-semicolon.csv (blank first line, ';') and santander-online-excel.csv (Account:/From: preamble) refused with the same generic message. — parseCSV picks the delimiter from line 1 only (a leading blank line forces ','), and takes rows[0] as the header. Santander midata variants (';' delimited, trailing ';', blank first line) parse into one column; the Online Banking CSV/Excel export starts with 'Account:'/'From:' preamble lines so the header is 'Account:,Santander…'. All refused with the same generic message.
findings.evidence: js/core/money.js:947-969 (delimiter and header from line 1); dialog run over money-samples/midata-semicolon.csv, santander-online-excel.csv
findings.fix: Detect the delimiter over the first ~10 non-empty lines; scan the first 20 rows for the first row that matches date+amount header patterns and treat everything above as preamble (show it as 'Skipped: 3 header lines'); drop trailing empty columns.
findings.rootCause: Header = rows[0], delimiter sniffed from text.split(/\r?\n/)[0].

findings.title: Santander's other exports (.txt, QIF, OFX) are not supported at all; the picker accepts .txt but cannot read it
findings.detail: Dialog run: santander-online.txt, santander.qif and santander.ofx all refused at step 1; the picker still accepts text/plain. — Online Banking 'Download transactions' offers text (Date:/Description:/Amount:/Balance: blocks with non-breaking spaces), Excel CSV, Quicken QIF and Microsoft Money OFX. The importer is CSV-only, yet the file input accepts text/plain, so the user's .txt is taken and fails with 'It has no header row with a date and an amount.' OFX would also give a stable FITID for exact de-duplication.
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:889 (accept), js/core/money.js:947; dialog run over the three samples
findings.fix: Add format sniffing: OFX/QFX (parse STMTTRN, use FITID as the dedupe key, LEDGERBAL to reconcile), QIF (D/T/P/M/^ records), the Santander .txt block format; name the format detected in the Columns step. Keep CSV for everything else.
findings.rootCause: Single CSV parser path.

findings.title: No way to see, undo or replace an import after the result dialog closes
findings.detail: Undo works only on the Done step (verified: 3 imported → Undo → 0). No other caller of undoBatch, no batch/source filter in list(), no select-all in the bulk bar. — Each import has a batch id, but 'Undo this import' exists only on the Done step of the dialog (money.js:915). Once closed there is no import history, no filter by source/batch in Transactions (list() filters kind/cat/tag/search only), and bulk select has no 'select all' over a range, so removing a bad 200-row import means ticking rows one by one.
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:915-917 (only undo), js/core/money.js:1050-1056 (only definition), 690-712 (list keep(): kind/cat/tag/search); grep undoBatch: 2 hits
findings.fix: An 'Imports' list (Transactions › Imports or Settings): file name, date range, rows, when imported, with Undo/Delete and 'Replace with a new file'. Store {batch, fileName, from, to, n, at} in state.money.imports. Add a Source filter and Select all in view.
findings.rootCause: Batch metadata is not stored anywhere but on rows; UI only exposes it in a transient dialog.

findings.title: Unquoted thousands separators shift columns: '£1,234.56' imports silently as £1.00
findings.detail: parse of 'Date,Description,Amount,Balance' + '27/10/2026,STUDENT FINANCE,£1,234.56,£1,500.00' gives 6 cells for a 4-column header and previews as ['in', 100] (£1.00). — A comma-delimited bank file that writes amounts like £1,234.56 without quotes (common in hand-rolled UK exports, and what users get after re-saving midata in a text editor) splits the amount into two cells. The parser never checks a row's cell count against the header, so the Student Finance row imported as +£1.00 and the balance column swallowed '234.56'. No warning in the preview.
findings.fix: Flag rows whose cell count differs from the header ('Row 3 has 6 cells, the header has 5'), and for the known Santander layout re-join a split £n,nnn.nn amount; show the running Balance column so a mismatch is visible.
findings.rootCause: Parser trusts column positions without validating row width.

findings.title: A recurring rule's 'Confirm' and an imported bank row for the same payment double-count
findings.detail: Fixture: rule 'Google One' £1.59 confirmed for 20 Jan, then a bank row '20/01/2027, GOOGLE *Google One, ON 19-01-2027, -1.59' previews duplicate:false and would import as a second £1.59. Seeded data shows the same for Student Finance (typed £450 on 27 Oct and the rule's 27 Oct occurrence still 'Due · 12 days ago' with a 'Received £450.00' button). — Confirming an occurrence (Google One £1.59, Phone £10) writes its own transaction r:<rule>:<date> with payee = rule name; importing the bank statement then adds 'GOOGLE *Google One, ON 27-10-2026' £1.59 as a separate row. Neither side looks at the other: preview's dedupe compares payee text ('google one' vs the bank string) and confirm() never searches existing transactions. Spend, budgets, Safe to spend and Reports count the payment twice. This is a second path to the duplicates the user saw.
findings.evidence: js/core/money.js:414-433, 1025-1031; eval t3.js confirmVsImport {dup:false}; #/money/recurring due card 'Student Finance · £450.00 | Due · 12 days ago'
findings.fix: On import, match rows to due occurrences (same amount ±0, date within ±3 days, payee alias set on the rule) and MARK the occurrence done pointing at the imported tx instead of creating a new one; on Confirm, offer 'Use the bank entry from 27 Oct' when one matches.
findings.rootCause: Rules and imports are two independent writers of the same real-world payment.

findings.title: Imported rows are unusable as information: raw bank strings, everything in Other, Type and Balance columns discarded
findings.detail: Workaround import (renamed headers) stores payee 'HERON FOODS HOYLAND (VIA APPLE PAY), ON 29-10-2026', cat 'other'; Type and Balance mapped to 'Leave out' with no option to use them. — Every imported row lands in Other/Other income (preview opts.outCat), payee is the raw bank text ('HERON FOODS HOYLAND (VIA APPLE PAY), ON 29-10-2026', 'CARD PAYMENT TO …,3.45 GBP, RATE 1.00/GBP ON …'), so Overview's 'This month by category' is one 'Other' bar, the Selected card shows a 4-line shouting title, spend-by-merchant is impossible and nothing learns from the user's re-categorising. The bank's Type (DEB/DD/FPI/FPO/SO) and Balance columns are dropped, so direct debits are not detected and the import cannot be reconciled. There is no merchant normalisation, no payee->category memory and no recurring detection anywhere in money.js.
findings.evidence: js/core/money.js:1019-1021, 1041; js/modules/money.js:962 (map options: date/payee/amount/out/in/note only); dialog map ['Type=>','Balance=>']
findings.fix: Revamp (see summary): store raw text, derive a clean merchant (strip 'CARD PAYMENT TO', '(VIA APPLE PAY)', ', ON dd-mm-yyyy', ',n.nn GBP, RATE …', store numbers, title-case); payee rules {match -> merchant, category} learned when the user sets a category ('Always put Heron Foods in Food?'); a built-in UK merchant table (Tesco, Heron Foods, Greggs, Stagecoach, Google, Spotify, SLC…); Type DD/SO -> suggest a recurring rule; Balance -> reconcile and show 'Matches the bank: £120.10'.
findings.rootCause: Import engine was built as a column copier ('the pages are phase 2' comment at money.js:946).

findings.title: iPhone: Money's Transactions, Month and year, Import/Export CSV and Goals' This week/This month/Done are unreachable
findings.detail: At iPhone size the only Money links on the Overview are Budgets →, Recurring →, Pots →; the 'Switch within Productivity' sheet lists Focus Timer…Money ✓, Goals only. — Under 700px the page's section tabs ([data-phone-tabs]) are hidden on the promise that the title bar's switch offers them, but mobile-shell's destinations() only falls back to page tabs when the section has no subnav. Productivity has a subnav, so the 'Switch within Productivity' sheet lists Focus Timer…Money, Goals, and Money's six views and Goals' four views vanish. On the Money overview the only visible links are Budgets →, Recurring →, Pots →; there is no way to open Transactions (where Import CSV lives) or Month and year. Goals: This week/This month/Done tabs measure 0x0.
findings.evidence: js/modules/mobile-shell.js:457-463, css/components.css:652-654; eval iphone: ctl list, sheet ['Focus Timer','Reminders10','Routines','Calendar','Money✓','Goals']; shots/money-goals/overview-iphone.png
findings.fix: In destinations(), when the page carries [data-phone-tabs] list those tabs in the sheet (as a second group under the section list), or keep the page tabs visible as a k-scroller strip under the title bar for Money and Goals.
findings.rootCause: Phone title bar prefers the section subnav and the CSS hides page tabs unconditionally.

findings.title: Import preview hides the payee and amount, and the Import button is below the fold
findings.detail: Mac 1470x832: dialog 760 wide, Preview card 264 wide, grid '150px 74px 0px 90px', payee 0px, amount x=1148 (card right 1087), Import button y=860 (> 832). iPhone: payee 0px and the amount (x 345–392) overflows the 362px card; iPad portrait: payee visible (310px) but the Import button sits at y=1182, below the 1180 viewport; the steps list still takes 160px at every size. — On the Mac (1470x832) the import dialog is 760px wide (it borrows Goals' --gl-dialog-w), the Columns card takes --mn-map-w, and the Preview card gets 264px. Its 4-column row grid (150px chip, 74px date, 1fr payee, 90px amount) leaves the payee 0px wide and pushes the amount to x=1148, outside the card (right edge 1087) — the preview shows only '+ New' and a date, so the user cannot check what will be imported. The 'Cannot read' row's reason is hidden the same way. The dialog body scrolls (907 > 713) and the footer with 'Import 4 entries' sits at y=860, off screen.
findings.evidence: eval scratchpad open.js mac {pvcard:[823,260,264,381], pvgrid:'150px 74px 0px 90px', amt:[1148,…], go y 860}; ipad {go:[624,1182,…]}; iphone {payee w 0, amt x 345 w 47, pvcard w 362}; css/views/money.css:135,169,176; shots/money-goals/import-preview-mac.png
findings.fix: Give the import dialog its own wide token (~1080px, full sheet on iPad), stack Columns above Preview below ~900px, shrink the state chip to its content, pin the footer (sticky) so Import is always visible.
findings.rootCause: Dialog width token from Goals + fixed grid columns.
findings.recheck: changed: also measured on iPad and iPhone

findings.title: Two genuine identical payments on the same day in one statement: the second is marked 'Already have' and skipped by default
findings.detail: previewCSV adds every row's key (date|amount|payee) to the seen set as it goes ('a repeat inside the same file is a duplicate too'), so two real card payments of the same amount at the same shop on the same day (two meal deals, two bus fares) are treated as one: the preview shows the second as '≈ Already have · matches an entry on 29 Oct' with Skip pre-selected, and Import imports one. Reproduced through the real dialog with midata-workaround.csv (two HERON FOODS -£3.45 rows on 29/10/2026 whose Balance column proves they are different: 120.10 vs 123.55): 'Preview 4 rows · 3 new · 1 look like ones you have', 'Import 3 entries'. Silent loss of real spending, and the totals under-report.
findings.evidence: js/core/money.js:1027-1031 (keys[k] = true inside the file loop); eval of the import dialog with money-samples/midata-workaround.csv: pv row 2 '≈ Already have … matches an entry on 29 Oct Skip'
findings.fix: Compare file rows only against what is STORED, not against earlier rows of the same file; for stored matches count multiplicity (n identical rows in the file vs m stored) and only flag the surplus. With a balance column (or OFX FITID) use it as part of the identity.
findings.rootCause: Within-file repeats are deliberately folded into the duplicate set.

findings.title: Re-importing the app's own CSV export turns every outgoing into income and files the category as a note
findings.detail: Export CSV writes 'Date,Type,Amount,Category,Payee,Note,Tags,Pot' with unsigned amounts and the kind in Type. guessMapping maps Amount as a signed column (no minus = money IN), ignores Type, and maps 'Category' to Note (the note pattern includes 'category' and Category comes first). Round trip of October's export: all 40 rows previewed as kind 'in' (e.g. Steam £14.38 'in', note 'Other'); only the duplicate check (same device, same data) stops them importing. On another device, after a reset or after 'Delete all', importing your own export (the only Money backup a user sees) books every expense as income; transfers lose their pot and splits come back as separate entries.
findings.evidence: js/core/money.js:973-977 (note: /category/), 1005-1013 (sign from the minus), 1058-1076 (export unsigned + Type); eval: roundtrip kinds {in: 40}, pv[0] ['2026-10-01','in',1438,'Steam','Other']
findings.fix: Recognise the app's own header exactly and import it losslessly (Type → kind, Category → cat by name, Pot → pot, Tags). Generally, offer a 'Type/Direction' column mapping (DEB/DD/SO/FPO = out, FPI/BGC/CR = in).
findings.rootCause: Export and import were written independently; the importer has no notion of a direction column.

findings.title: iPhone and iPad portrait: tapping a transaction shows nothing; its Edit and Delete sit below the whole list
findings.detail: Under 860px .k-mn-cols becomes one column and the side column (the Selected card with Edit · Duplicate · Delete…, and This view) is placed after the list. Tapping a row only marks it selected; nothing on screen changes. With 'The last 3 months' the Edit button is at y=4644 on iPhone (viewport 874) and y=4288 on iPad portrait (viewport 1180), after 60 rows, and the IntersectionObserver keeps loading more rows as you approach it, so it moves away. On the user's two touch devices there is effectively no way to correct or delete an imported duplicate one by one (bulk tick-and-delete is the only route).
findings.evidence: css/views/money.css:343-345 (side under the list ≤860px); js/modules/money.js:601-602 (row click only re-draws the side); eval iphone: editY 4644 vs innerHeight 874; eval ipad: rowY 684, editY 4288; shots/money-goals/r2-tx-iphone.png
findings.fix: Under 860px open the entry in a sheet (the entry editor or the Selected card as a k-msheet) on tap; keep 'This view' above the list as a summary line.
findings.rootCause: The desktop master-detail layout is stacked without changing the interaction.

findings.title: Month and year: 'In' shows expected income as if received
findings.detail: Month and year, November so far: 'IN £450.00 · £450.00 still expected' while nothing has arrived. — For the current month the side card's In figure is ins.planned (received + still expected), e.g. 'IN £450.00 · £450.00 still expected' when nothing has come in yet. The headline figure should be what came in, with expected as the sub-line.
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:1695-1697 (inFig = ins.planned); shots/money-goals/r2-month-mac.png
findings.fix: fig('In', cur.income, expected ? '+' + said(expected) + ' still expected' : null).
findings.rootCause: inFig uses ins.planned

findings.title: 'Never printed' card shows designer rules to the user
findings.detail: The 'Never printed' card is still in Month and year's side column. — Month and year's side column contains a card titled 'Never printed' explaining 'Never a bare 0 or +∞%' — an implementation rule from the design notes, meaningless to the user and violating invariant 50a (rules belong in Help & Guide).
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:1698; shots/money-goals/r2-month-mac.png
findings.fix: Remove the card; use the column for something useful (top merchants this month, biggest change, the month's subscriptions).
findings.rootCause: Design annotation shipped as UI copy.

findings.title: Money's section tabs jump between pages (Add entry button appears on some pages only)
findings.detail: Mac: tab strip x=615,y=185 on Overview/Transactions/Recurring; x=741,y=164 on Budgets/Pots; x=740,y=185 on Month and year (Add entry absent on the last three). Hide amounts ends at x=1446, the band's edge. — On Overview/Transactions/Recurring the tab strip spans x≈617–1180 with '+ Add entry' after it; on Budgets/Pots/Month and year there is no Add entry and the strip sits at x≈742–1305 and vertically centred differently (y 183 vs 204). Switching tabs makes the control you just clicked move under the pointer. The strip and Hide amounts pill also sit over the painted header band, Hide amounts touching its right edge on Budgets/Pots.
findings.evidence: eval hdr.js mac: tabs rects per route; js/modules/money.js:134-135
findings.fix: Keep Add entry (or a placeholder of equal width) on every Money page, or put the section tabs on their own row left-aligned under the title as other Productivity pages do.
findings.rootCause: header() actions differ per view in js/modules/money.js

findings.title: Pots: empty right column beside the pot cards, and Move money's tabs/select clipped
findings.detail: Pots at 1470: Emergency card + 'Saving for something?' tile end at x≈1036, leaving ~410px empty to the right; Move money shows 'Between pots' cut at the card edge and the To select 'New laptop fc'. — With two pots the grid shows Emergency and the 'Saving for something?' tile, leaving a ~410px empty column on the right (x 1036–1446). The Move money card clips 'Between pots' at its right edge and the To select shows 'New laptop fc'.
findings.evidence: shots/money-goals/r2-pots-mac.png
findings.fix: Use auto-fill grid with minmax so cards stretch (or put Move money in the empty column); let the Move money segments wrap and put From/To on separate rows under ~360px.
findings.rootCause: Fixed-column pot grid; segmented control without wrap.

findings.title: iPhone Recurring: the third occurrence tile is cut off at the card edge
findings.detail: iPhone #/money/recurring: k-mn-occ-i right edges 410 (Sat 28 Nov, Fri 27 Nov, Wed 25 Nov) past the 402 viewport. — At 402px each due rule shows three occurrence tiles in a row; the third (Sat 28 Nov · Upcoming) runs to x=410, past the card and viewport, reading "Upcomi" / "Sat 28 No". It is not a declared scroller (invariant 50). The New rule form is also always expanded at the bottom of the phone page and the + FAB covers its Next-dates line.
findings.evidence: DOM measure iphone (mg-m2.js): overflow ['k-mn-occ-i:Sat 28 Nov○ Upcoming£1.59 r=410', …]
findings.fix: Under 560px show two tiles (last + next) or wrap them; make the tile row a KOS.ui.scroller if three are needed; collapse New rule behind the + New rule button on phone.
findings.rootCause: Fixed 3-column occurrence grid without a phone tier

findings.title: Goal page: status chip unreadable on the painted band, and a mostly empty page
findings.detail: #/goals/1 on Mac: 'Met' chip on the painted band at low contrast, one stats card and ~400px of empty page below; 'THE LINE SAYS 0.2 titles' (fractional titles). — On #/goals/<id> the 'Too early to call' chip sits on the header painting at very low contrast (grey text on mid-tone art). The page body is one stats card and two small side cards; for a Collection titles goal it never lists which titles count or what to read next, and it does not link to them, leaving ~400px of empty page at 1470x832. Fractional 'The line says 0.3 titles' for a count of titles reads oddly.
findings.evidence: shots/money-goals/r2-goal-detail-mac.png
findings.fix: Give band chips a solid scrim background (as the Hide amounts pill has); for count goals list the counted/remaining items with links into the vault (connected OS); round the line for integer units ('on pace: 0 of 12 by today').
findings.rootCause: Detail page draws only aggregate facts.

findings.title: Painted page header shows the PREVIOUS page's picture (Goals shows Money's jar, Money shows Goals' mountain)
findings.detail: Sequence goals → money → … → goals → money/budgets: #/goals shows app.hero.page.money.webp, #/money shows app.hero.page.goals.webp, #/money/budgets after #/goals shows goals' picture; the same pages loaded from themselves show their own. — KOS.ui.pageHeader picks its art from KOS.store.state.ui.view, but KOS.show only sets ui.view AFTER the view function has rendered. So the first render of any page that relies on PAGE_ART draws the art of the page you came from; a redraw on the same page then corrects it. Reproduced: money -> goals gives app.hero.page.money.webp on Goals; goals -> money/budgets gives app.hero.page.goals.webp on Money. Affects every page in PAGE_ART (Review, Assignments, Exams, Pacing, Calendar, Reminders, Routines, Goals, Money, Wishlist, Governor, Reports, Archive...).
findings.evidence: eval hdr.js imgs per route (mac and ipad); js/core/ui.js:589-592, 1540-1543; shots/money-goals/r2-goals-week-empty-mac.png (Money's jar on Goals)
findings.fix: Set KOS.store.state.ui.view (or a transient KOS.ui.rendering = viewId) before calling KOS.views[viewId], or have pageHeader take the view id from the router's current call.
findings.rootCause: Ordering in KOS.show: state.ui.view assigned after render.

findings.title: CSS class collision: first-run steps and the import stepper share .k-mn-steps/.k-mn-step, breaking both
findings.detail: First-run steps' number circles at x=893/921/897 (centred per row, flex-direction column, align-items center); the import stepper is 160px tall at every size. — css/views/money.css defines .k-mn-steps/.k-mn-step/.k-mn-step-n twice: once for the import dialog's horizontal stepper (158-163) and again for the first-run checklist (319-321). The later column layout makes the import stepper a vertical centred list that eats ~170px of the dialog; the earlier align-items:center leaks into the first-run list, so its numbered circles sit at different x (906/934/910) because each step is centred by its own width.
findings.evidence: eval empty account: k-mn-step-n x [893,921,897]; css/views/money.css:158-163 vs 319-321; shots/money-goals/r2-money-empty-mac.png
findings.fix: Rename one set (e.g. .k-mn-istep for the import stepper) and set align-items: stretch on the first-run list.
findings.rootCause: Duplicate selectors in one view stylesheet.

findings.title: Transactions 'This view' totals cover only the rows loaded so far
findings.detail: Range Everything: side card 'This view 60 entries so far · Everything In +£1,336.80 Out −£548.55' while 118 entries exist. — With range 'Everything' the side card reads '60 entries so far · In +£1,337.80 · Out −£509.51' — totals of the first lazy batch, not of the period. A user checking a month's spend gets a partial figure that changes as they scroll.
findings.evidence: eval #/money/transactions range=all; js/modules/money.js:652-670 (sums shown)
findings.fix: Compute the range totals with KOS.money.rangeSummary(from,to) (index read, no rendering) and keep the lazy list for rows only.
findings.rootCause: Totals derived from the rendered batch.

findings.title: iPad: Money header wraps Add entry to its own row and clips Hide amounts; filter selects are 30px on touch
findings.detail: iPad portrait: Hide amounts ends exactly at the band edge (672+132=804) and Add entry wraps to y=306 (band 202px tall). The 30px selects (Category, Dates, Budgets' payday) and 41px rows are also 30–35px on iPhone (tx-cat 199x35, tx-range 173x35, payday 78x35) and on iPad LANDSCAPE (tx-cat 165x30, tx-row 560x41, Pots ⋯ 44x32, Recurring number inputs 43–50x40), where the earlier check did not look. — At 820x1180 the section tabs + Hide amounts fill the band row, Hide amounts' right border is cut at the band edge (x 804), and '+ Add entry' drops to a second row, making the band 220px tall with a gap. On Transactions the Category and Dates selects are 30px tall and rows 41px, under the 44px touch minimum (invariant 69); Pots' ⋯ menu button is 44x32 and Budgets' month-start select 70x30.
findings.evidence: eval hdr.js ipad; DOM measure ipad/iphone/ipadl (m4.js, touch threshold at every width); shots/money-goals/tx-ipad.png
findings.fix: Move section tabs to their own row below the title at <=1080px; apply the coarse-pointer 44px rule to .k-pill-select and menu buttons.
findings.rootCause: Header actions row not tiered for 701-1080; pill-select lacks coarse-pointer sizing.

findings.title: Amounts written as (3.45) or 3.45 DR import as money in
findings.detail: toMinor strips everything but digits, '.', ',' and '-', so accountant notation '(3.45)' and suffixed '3.45 DR' become +3.45 and the row is previewed as '+£3.45' income; '3.45-' (trailing minus) is rejected as 'no amount'. Statements and spreadsheet re-saves use these notations. Dates written with a month name ('06 Oct 2026', as Nationwide and many PDFs-to-CSV tools write them) are rejected as 'No date I can read'.
findings.evidence: js/core/money.js:63-70; dialog preview of money-samples/odd-amounts.csv: 'PAREN NEG +£3.45', 'DR SUFFIX +£3.45', row 5 'no amount'
findings.fix: In toMinor treat (x), trailing '-', 'DR'/'CR' and 'D'/'C' suffixes as signs; flag any row whose sign was inferred.
findings.rootCause: toMinor only knows a leading minus.

findings.title: Editing a transfer into a move between two pots keeps the original and adds two new entries
findings.detail: In the entry editor, save() handles 'pot → pot' by calling addTx twice and returns before the existing/updateTx branch, so editing an existing transfer (e.g. the £120 Main → New laptop top-up) to 'New laptop → Emergency' leaves the original untouched and adds an out and an in. Reproduced through Transactions → select → Edit → From/To → Save: transfers went from 1 to 3 entries.
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:814-821 (early return before line 832 updateTx); eval: before [[2026-10-28,laptop,in,12000]] after adds [laptop,out,12000],[emergency,in,12000]
findings.fix: When editing, turn the existing entry into one half (updateTx) and add only the other; or delete the original in the same step with an undo.
findings.rootCause: The between-pots path was written for new entries only.

findings.title: Bulk 'Set category' puts income entries into spending categories
findings.detail: The bulk bar's Set category menu lists only Out categories and applies to every ticked entry except transfers and planner rows, including income. An income entry moved to Food keeps kind 'in' and appears in Food's row as income (summary byCat.food.income 4000) while the Budgets bar only reads net spend, so the money disappears from Other income and from the income figures by category. Reproduced via updateTx with the same patch bulkSet sends.
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:622-624, 641-649; eval: income £40 → {kind:'in', cat:'food'}, summary food {income:4000, out:1000}
findings.fix: Split the menu (Out categories for out/refund rows, In categories for income) or skip and report rows whose kind does not match the chosen category.

findings.title: Recurring: an occurrence left unconfirmed for more than 14 days disappears; older months are never offered
findings.detail: The due cards read M.upcoming(today−14, today) and show only the newest due occurrence per rule, three rules at most. With Spotify (monthly on the 12th since 12 Aug) never confirmed, its 12 Aug, 12 Sep and 12 Oct occurrences are all state 'due', yet Recurring shows no card for it and its rule row only says 'Next Thu 12 Nov'; Phone's 25 Oct card ('Due · 14 days ago') vanishes tomorrow. The payments silently never enter spend, budgets or Reports, and nothing tells the user. 'Leave it upcoming' (for a payment already past) is kept in per-visit memory (visit.left) so the card returns on the next visit.
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:1213-1216 (14-day window, one per rule, slice 3), 1251 (visit.left); eval on #/money/recurring: due cards [Google One 11 days ago, Student Finance 12, Phone 14]; Spotify occurrences 2026-08-12/09-12/10-12 all 'due'
findings.fix: List every unconfirmed past occurrence (grouped per rule, 'Spotify · 3 not confirmed'), with Confirm all / Skip all; mark the rule row with a due count; once bank import exists, match them to imported rows instead.
findings.rootCause: The due list is a recent window, not 'everything not yet decided'.

findings.title: Money goals are met with no evidence: 'No-spend days' counts days with no entries at all, and 'Spend under' is met by an empty month
findings.detail: money-no-spend counts every day of the period up to today on which no 'out' entry exists, so on an account with zero Money entries a weekly '5 no-spend days' goal created today reads '✓ Met · 7 of 5 days · Met. Nothing more to do here.' (it also counts days before the goal existed). money-spend-under reads 0 spent for a month with no entries and will be judged met at the end of the period. A user who simply did not log spending is told they kept their goal, and the outcome is stored in the goal's history. The Overview makes the same claim: its chip read '7 no-spend days' on a month with entries on one day, while Safe to spend in the same hero says it needs 7 days WITH entries — the two disagree about what an empty day means.
findings.evidence: js/core/goals.js:680-711; empty account (reset), goals added via KOS.goals.add: #/goals text '✓ Met | 5 no-spend days | 7 | of 5 days | Met. Nothing more to do here.' and 'Your run … 2 met this week'; shots/money-goals/r2-goals-thin-mac.png; shots/money-goals/r2-overview-dawn-mac.png (chip '7 no-spend days', '1 day so far')
findings.fix: Require evidence that Money is in use for the period (entries on at least N days, or an import covering the range) before judging; otherwise read 'Not enough entries to judge'. Start counting from the goal's creation day.
findings.rootCause: Absence of data is read as absence of spending.

findings.title: Budgets: the Payday day picker does nothing while the month starts on the 1st, then Payday ignores the day you picked
findings.detail: On Budgets the side card shows the segment The 1st | Payday · the 28th and a separate Payday is the [28th] select. Its change handler only saves when monthStart is already not 1, so a user on The 1st who picks 15th sees the select change but nothing is saved, and pressing Payday then sets the 28th. The first-run card offers Payday with no day at all (silently the 28th), and paydays after the 28th (last working day, the 30th/31st) cannot be chosen.
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:1093-1097, 198-202; eval on #/money/budgets: pick 15 → monthStart 1; click Payday → monthStart 28
findings.fix: Picking a day should switch to Payday on that day; show the day picker in first-run; allow Last day of the month (periodRange already clamps).
findings.rootCause: The select is gated on the current mode instead of setting it.

findings.title: New entry: switching Out to In keeps the Out category, so income is saved under Food while the picker shows Job
findings.detail: The editor's category lines start as Food for an Out entry. Switching the type to In redraws the select with income categories only; the browser shows the first option (Job) but the line's cat stays 'food' because no change event fires, and Save stores {kind:'in', cat:'food'}. The income then appears under Food (byCat.food.income) and not under any income category. The reverse switch stores an Out entry under 'Other income'. The Payee placeholder also stays 'Who you paid' after switching to In.
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:736-737 (lines start with food), 765-767 (select drawn from the new kind, ln.cat untouched), 731 (placeholder fixed at creation); UI repro: New entry → In → 12.34 → Save: stored ['in','food',1234], summary food {income:1234}
findings.fix: On a kind switch reset each line's cat to the new kind's default when it is not one of that kind's categories (and update the placeholder).
findings.rootCause: Select value and model diverge when the option set changes.

findings.title: Phone section sheet stays open across navigation and shows the wrong page ticked
findings.detail: Opening the sheet at iPhone size and navigating to #/goals leaves it open with 'Money ✓'; it then survived a resize to Mac and was still covering Month and year and Pots at 1470x832 two navigations later. — Opening 'Switch within Productivity' on Goals and then navigating (back gesture / hash change) leaves the sheet over the new page with 'Goals ✓' while Money is shown; it even survived a viewport change to iPad width.
findings.evidence: shots/money-goals/r2-stale-sheet-iphone.png, shots/money-goals/r2-month-mac.png and first r2-pots-mac attempt (sheet over the Mac page); DOM: section.k-msheet[data-ui~='shell.section-sheet']
findings.fix: Close activeSectionOverlay on every KOS.show / hashchange in mobile-shell.js.
findings.rootCause: mobile-shell openSection overlay not tied to navigation.

findings.title: Goals: zero counts printed and empty-state card leaves a dead half
findings.detail: With no goals at all, This week now shows a 'Pick a first goal' template card (no 'All 0', no half-empty card); five 186px templates leave ~200px empty on the right at 1470. With goals present, 'Your run' still prints '0 behind this week'. — This week with no goals shows the filter pill 'All 0' (invariant 77) and an empty-state card whose picture and one line sit in the left 60% with no action, next to the 'Aim at something new' card. 'Your run' paints '0 behind this week' in the alarm colour even when nothing is behind.
findings.evidence: shots/money-goals/r2-goals-week-empty-mac.png; #/goals text with three Money goals: '0 | behind this week | 1 | on track this week | 2 | met this week'
findings.fix: Hide the count at 0 (or the whole domain pill row when empty); put New goal / templates in the empty card; use muted tone for a zero 'behind'.
findings.rootCause: Pill count and stat tone not zero-aware.
findings.recheck: changed: the never-had-goals state is new

findings.title: Import error rows read 'no date i can read' (lower-case I)
findings.detail: previewCard lower-cases the whole reason ('No date I can read' → 'Row 7: no date i can read. It will be left out.').
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:998 (e.reason.toLowerCase()); dialog preview of odd-amounts.csv
findings.fix: Lower-case only the first character, or write the reasons in sentence form already.

findings.title: Editing a confirmed recurring entry's amount leaves Recurring showing the old amount
findings.detail: A confirmed occurrence keeps its amount in the rule's mark (marks[date].minor), and upcoming() prints that. Editing the transaction in Transactions (updateTx) does not touch the mark, so Recurring says £10.00 while the entry and every total say £20.00.
findings.evidence: js/core/money.js:454-458 (upcoming reads m.minor), 666-675 (updateTx ignores rule); eval editConfirmed {recurringShows:1000, txIs:2000}
findings.fix: Read the amount from the linked transaction, or update the mark (and its changed flag) in updateTx when cur.rule is set.

findings.title: Transactions search ignores category names and amounts
findings.detail: list() matches the search box against payee, note and tags only. Typing 'Food', a custom category name or '120' finds nothing even though those are what a user scans the list by.
findings.evidence: js/core/money.js:698 (keep: payee+note+tags); eval search {byCat:0, byAmount:0} with matching entries present
findings.fix: Include the category name and the formatted amount in the haystack (or parse a number query as an amount match).

findings.title: A closed pot cannot be reopened, and the money still in it drops out of every view
findings.detail: Close pot archives it (updatePot archived:true). Pots, Overview's Pots card and the Move money pickers list only pots() (unarchived) and there is no Archived pots section or Reopen anywhere (grep: no restore for pots, unlike categories' Restore). The confirm warns the money stays inside, but once closed the user cannot move it back out or see the balance.
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:1556-1560 (closePot), 459-475 and 753 (pots() only); grep 'Reopen|reopen' finds nothing
findings.fix: Add a 'Closed pots' list with Reopen (like Budgets' Archived categories), or move the remaining balance back to Main as part of closing.

findings.title: With Hide amounts on, a money goal's figure reads '– / of · 8 of 30 days gone'
findings.detail: On a Money goal's page the current and target figures are dropped when amounts are hidden but the joining words stay, leaving a dash and a dangling 'of ·'. Every other surface masks the figure in place (KOS.ui.amount keeps the width).
findings.evidence: shots/money-goals/r2-goal-money-hidden-mac.png (#/goals/10, 'Spend under 200', Hide amounts on)
findings.fix: Use KOS.ui.amount's mask for goal figures too, or drop the whole 'of …' phrase when hidden.

findings.title: Recurring rule rows are role=button cards that contain buttons
findings.detail: Each rule row is a div role=button tabindex=0 'Edit <name>' and, for a trial, holds 'Remind me' / '✓ Reminder set' buttons inside it (invariant 67: a card with interactive descendants is not an ARIA button). Screen readers flatten the nested button; Space does not activate the row (only Enter is handled).
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:1285-1288
findings.fix: Make the name a real button (or link) and keep the row a plain listitem.

findings.title: Income categories can be added but never renamed, recoloured or archived
findings.detail: Budgets' '+ Add category' offers Kind: Spending | Income, but Budgets lists only Out categories (M.categories({kind:'out'})) and every Rename/Colour/Archive action lives in a budget row's ⋯ menu. An income category made by mistake (or the defaults Job, Allowance, Grants…) has no surface to manage it. The Add dialog also keeps the 'Monthly budget' field when Income is picked, though normalise drops an income budget.
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:1067 (out only), 1119-1131 (actions per out row), 1188-1190 (budget field regardless of kind); js/core/money.js:113 (in → budget null)
findings.fix: Add an 'Income categories' card on Budgets' side (rename, colour, archive), and hide the budget field when Income is picked.

findings.title: Month and year: a past month's category row opens Transactions on 'Everything', and Export CSV ignores the month on screen
findings.detail: Clicking a category row in a past month sets the Transactions range to 'all' (only the current month maps to a range), so October's 'Food' opens every Food entry ever, with the partial 'This view' totals. The page's Export CSV opens the shared dialog whose 'This view' is Transactions' range (txRange), not the month or year being looked at, and 'This month' is today's month.
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:1681 (range 'all' unless current), 1655 + 1022-1036 (exportDialog uses txRange())
findings.fix: Add a custom from/to range to Transactions and pass the month's range; give the export dialog the caller's range.

findings.title: Year view: 'Set aside · 2 pots' counts every open pot, and the dashed income line carries no amount
findings.detail: The Set aside figure's sub-line is M.pots().length (all open pots), so £120 moved into one pot reads '£120.00 · 2 pots'. The chart's subtitle promises 'income where it was recorded, as the dashed line', but .k-mn-yin is only a marker at the baseline under months with any income: its amount is not drawn, so income cannot be compared with spending (Aug in ≈ £700 vs out £264).
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:1742 (M.pots().length), 1722 (k-mn-yin with no height variable); shots/money-goals/r2-year-mac.png
findings.fix: Count the pots that received money in the range; draw income at its height (or print it under the bar).

findings.title: A subscription's price rise can never be recorded: setPrice has no caller, and editing the amount re-prices past occurrences
findings.detail: KOS.money keeps a price history (prices, setPrice, priceChange) and the Overview and Recurring draw '▲ Up from … more a year' from it, but nothing in the app or the Assistant calls setPrice. Changing the amount in the rule editor overwrites minor, so every unconfirmed past occurrence now shows the new price and the price-rise notice never appears.
findings.evidence: grep setPrice: only js/core/money.js:390 and the export; js/modules/money.js:436, 452, 1275 read priceChange; ruleEditor save → updateRule(minor)
findings.fix: When the amount of a rule with confirmed history changes, ask 'From when?' and call setPrice(id, amount, from).

findings.title: Import preview shows only the first 80 rows without saying so
findings.detail: previewCard draws pv.rows.slice(0, 80) while its header says e.g. '400 rows · 390 new'. A year's statement can only be checked for its first 80 rows; duplicates and unreadable rows further down cannot be seen or toggled (their 'Import anyway' choice is unreachable). Cannot-read rows are appended after the 80, so they are listed but the duplicates past 80 are not.
findings.evidence: js/modules/money.js:989 (slice(0, 80)), 1001 (header counts all rows)
findings.fix: Virtualise or page the preview, and put duplicates and errors first with counts.

findings.title: CSV export does not neutralise cells that start with = + - @ (bank descriptions can carry formulas into Excel)
findings.detail: csvCell only quotes cells containing quote, comma, newline or ';'. Payees come straight from imported bank text (merchant-controlled), so a description such as '=HYPERLINK(…)' is written as a live formula when the export is opened in Excel/Numbers.
findings.evidence: js/core/money.js:1057 (csvCell), js/modules/money.js:1039-1046 (selection export, same rule)
findings.fix: Prefix a single quote (or a tab) to cells beginning with = + - @, as OWASP recommends for CSV export.

backlog: Import revamp, step 1 — a real pipeline: detect format by content not header line (skip preamble lines until a row with a date-like and money-like column; sniff ';' ',' tab over the first 20 lines; decode Windows-1252 when UTF-8 yields U+FFFD), and add readers for Santander .txt blocks, QIF and OFX/QFX (FITID) alongside CSV; offer the column mapper whenever detection is unsure instead of refusing.

Import revamp, step 2 — identity and reconciliation: store per row its source (bank, account, FITID or a hash of date+amount+description+balance+occurrence index) so the same statement re-imported is recognised whatever the mapping; use the Balance column to verify ordering and catch missing or duplicated rows ('Balance after 29 Oct should be £120.10, Money says £116.65'); match imported rows to confirmed recurring occurrences and typed entries (date ±3 days, same amount) and offer 'This is the same as …' instead of adding twins.

Import revamp, step 3 — information a Santander student needs: merchant normalisation ('HERON FOODS HOYLAND (VIA APPLE PAY), ON 29-10-2026' / 'CARD PAYMENT TO … RATE 1.00/GBP ON …' → 'Heron Foods', keeping the raw text as the note), Santander Type codes (DEB, DD, SO, FPI, FPO, BGC, CR, ATM) mapped to direction and kind, payee→category rules learned from the user's re-categorising ('Always put Heron Foods in Food'), recurring detection (same merchant, same amount, ~monthly → 'Make Google One a rule?'), spend by merchant and by week, and the account balance over time from the Balance column.

Import history page (Archive or Money › Imports): every batch with file name, date range, counts (added, duplicates, unreadable), and Undo / Delete / Replace with a newer statement; a 'Imported' source filter and select-all in Transactions.
Touch layout for Transactions: tap opens the entry in a sheet; 'This view' totals computed for the whole range (a count query), shown above the list.
A 'Not yet confirmed' queue for Recurring covering every past occurrence, with Confirm all / Skip all and automatic matching to imported rows.
qol: Year view: draw income at its height so in vs out reads at a glance.
Day chart: tapping a day opens Transactions filtered to that day.
Pots 'Recent moves → Transactions' should open Transactions filtered to pot moves (there is no transfer filter today).
Overview's Safe to spend side card has a ~77px empty spacer above the In/Out rows in the low-data state (seen at mac and iPad landscape).
The page kicker reads '円 · The month' on Pots, Recurring and Transactions too.
The phone FAB covers the amount column of the row under it while scrolling Transactions (r2-tx-iphone.png).
The Bookkeeper badge counts imported duplicates; once identity exists, count distinct entries.
